options.fig.alt: Bar chart: physicians make up about 1% of the U.S. adult workforce, but 22% of third-year medical students in a national study had a physician parent or grandparent.

options.label: family-loop
options.fig.alt: Causal loop diagram. Parents' degree status and parents' unmet dreams both raise perceived expectations, which raise pressure to achieve. Pressure raises perfectionism and stress, which raise fear of disappointing family, which reduces help-seeking, which raises stress further. Achievement raises the family's expectations further. Open family conversations and academic support reduce perceived pressure.
